title: Build the internal tools your Django project needs
excerpt: Build customer support consoles, billing operations pages, approval workflows, and other staff tools inside Django Admin, with your coding agent or by hand.
content_html:
Ask your coding agent

Build a tool for support to look up a customer and their subscriptions.

Install the agent skills

Start building

Let your coding agent do the scaffolding, or start from a command yourself.

1

Add the skills to your agent

/plugin install dcr --marketplace django-control-room/skills

2

Describe the tool you need

Build a tool for our support team to look up a customer and their recent orders.

Full instructions and other agents

One dashboard for every tool you build

Django Control Room adds a hub to Django Admin where your team finds every tool, whether it lives in your project or ships as a package.

The foundation is already built

You worry about the business rules. DCR handles the rest.

Tables, stats, pills, and buttons that look consistent without custom CSS.

Webhook deliveries

Retry allExport

user.deleted● FAILED
